steps.title: Two counters, two instances
steps.text: `src/index.js` renders one `Counter` class twice. While the page loaded, each counter logged `mounted after insertion`, its name and `true`: `componentDidMount` runs in a second step, commit, after the button is already in the page.
steps.textZh: `src/index.js` 把同一个 `Counter` class 渲染了两次。页面加载时，每个计数器都打印了 `mounted after insertion`、自己的名字和 `true`：`componentDidMount` 在第二步，也就是 commit 阶段才运行，那时按钮已经在页面上了。

steps.title: Click First
steps.text: The click calls `setState` on the first instance only. `setState` merges the new count into that instance's state and calls the update function the instance got when it was mounted. **First** goes up; **Second** stays at 0.
steps.textZh: 这次点击只调用了第一个实例的 `setState`。`setState` 把新的计数合并进这个实例的状态，再调用它在挂载时拿到的更新函数。于是**第一个**加一，**第二个**仍是 0。

steps.title: The clicked button is a new element
steps.titleZh: 被点的按钮已经换成新元素
steps.text: An update does not compare the old result with the new one, as React does. It renders again, builds new DOM nodes and swaps them in. This button keeps a reference to the **First** button, clicks it, and compares: the page now holds a different element, and the old one has left the page.
steps.textZh: 更新时不会像 React 那样比较新旧结果，而是重新渲染、创建新的 DOM 节点，再把它们换上去。这个按钮先记住**第一个**按钮，点击它，再做比较：页面里已经是另一个元素了，旧的那个已经离开了页面。

action.run: const before = document.querySelector('#root button'); before.click(); const after = document.querySelector('#root button'); console.log('same element after the click:', before === after); console.log('old element still in the page:', before.isConnected)

steps.actionLabel: Click First and compare the elements
steps.actionLabelZh: 点击「第一个」并比较前后的元素
expectConsole: same element after the click: false
old element still in the page: false

steps.title: Second keeps its own state
steps.text: Each instance gets its own update function when it is mounted, so the two counters never mix up their state. A click on **Second** changes only **Second**.
steps.textZh: 每个实例在挂载时都会拿到自己的更新函数，所以两个计数器的状态从不混在一起。点击**第二个**只会改变**第二个**。

steps.title: Try the keyboard
steps.text: Clicks log nothing: `Counter` has no `componentDidUpdate`, and `componentDidMount` runs only when a counter is first added. Now press Tab until a counter has focus, then press Space: the count goes up, but the focus is gone, because the button that had it was replaced.
steps.textZh: 点击不会打印任何东西：`Counter` 没有 `componentDidUpdate`，`componentDidMount` 也只在计数器第一次加入页面时运行。现在按 Tab 键，直到焦点落在某个计数器上，再按空格：计数加一，焦点却不见了，因为拥有焦点的那个按钮被换掉了。
